source.note: Wave-1 row 10 named the Quaternius Animated Animals cat (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; its Google Drive is quota-blocked). This is the reachable Quaternius tuxedo cat from Animal Pack Vol.2 (OpenGameArt, CC0), with Idle and Walking only. No better free animated cat was reachable: Kenney's Cube Pets cat is blocky, the CC0 OpenGameArt 'low poly cat thing' is Collada only, and the itch.io cats are paid or under custom licences. height 0.4 m is the raised tail tip; the ear tips sit at 0.30 m, a house cat's real size.
